en.title: Halle Berry, Regina King, Meg Ryan Join Tribeca & Chanel's Filmmaker Program
en.summary: Three iconic actresses are lending their expertise to champion emerging female filmmakers. The Tribeca Chanel Through Her Lens program welcomes a stellar jury for its 2026 edition.
en.body:
The film world is getting a major dose of star power dedicated to fostering new talent. **Halle Berry**, **Regina King**, and **Meg Ryan** have been announced as jurors for the 11th edition of the **Through Her Lens: The Tribeca Chanel Women’s Filmmaker Program**. This prestigious artist-development initiative, a collaboration between **Tribeca Enterprises** and **Chanel**, is designed to support and elevate emerging women and non-binary filmmakers.

The program, set to take place from September 22-24 in New York, provides a vital platform for storytellers to hone their craft and advance their careers. Alongside the celebrated actors, the jury will also include acclaimed cinematographer **Autumn Durald Arkapaw** and actress **Ella Rubin**, bringing a wealth of cinematic knowledge and experience to the selection process.

## Championing New Voices in Cinema

The Through Her Lens program is more than just a competition; it's a comprehensive mentorship and development experience. Industry mentors such as **Celine Song** (director of *Past Lives*), **Aleshea Harris**, **Ellen Goldsmith-Vein**, **Fala Chen**, and **Gina Prince-Bythewood** will guide the selected filmmakers. This blend of seasoned jurors and dedicated mentors creates an unparalleled environment for growth, offering invaluable feedback and industry connections. The program’s commitment to spotlighting underrepresented voices is crucial, aiming to diversify the storytelling landscape and ensure a richer, more inclusive future for cinema.

## Why This Matters to Film Fans

For passionate film fans, this announcement signifies a direct investment in the future of movies we’ll all be talking about. Knowing that artists like **Halle Berry**, **Regina King**, and **Meg Ryan** are actively involved in discovering and supporting new talent is incredibly heartening. Their discerning eyes and industry experience will undoubtedly help identify groundbreaking projects that resonate with audiences. This program isn't just about individual filmmakers; it's about the collective cinematic experience, ensuring a pipeline of fresh perspectives and innovative storytelling reaches our screens. It’s a powerful reminder that the magic of cinema is constantly being reinvented by new generations, with a little help from established icons.

## What's Next

As the program unfolds from September 22-24, all eyes will be on the emerging filmmakers and the projects they present. We can anticipate exciting announcements regarding the selected fellows and their work in the coming months, promising a glimpse into the future of filmmaking.
